title: 第10章 异朽阁的妖精
slug: 花千骨全本免费-花千骨最新章节列表
content_zh:
“糖宝，不准再叫我妈妈了哦！别人会误会的！你叫我千骨吧！”
“可是你是我妈妈啊。”糖宝无精打采的趴在花千骨耳朵里，怀里还抱了粒馒头屑当枕头。
“呃，至少不要在外人面前那么叫吧。”
“那我就跟着爸爸一样叫你骨头，我喜欢骨头！”
“你是虫子又不是狗，干吗喜欢骨头啊？”
“我不是虫子，等我灵力有了一定提高，我会变身的！”
“变身？变成什么？变蝴蝶么？那还不是虫子。”
“呃，我也不知道。可是那时候我就会飞了！不用每天爬来爬去。”
“是啊，好慢啊，要是像你，我下辈子都到不了昆仑山了。”
“放心啦，我们很快就要到了。明天应该就能赶到昆仑山脚下，再过三日才是群仙宴，我认得路的，一定来得及。”
“你怎么知道啊？”
“我可是异朽阁的妖精，专职负责消息打探和传输消息，怎么会不知道啊！”
“好厉害啊！”
“哈哈，那是当然！”
“对了，要是我拜了白子画老前辈做师父的话，他要收了你怎么办？我是不是应该把你藏好啊？”
“不用的啦，我又不是什么邪术成精的，只是秘术，而且没什么法力，这世上的精怪多的去呢，像我这种善良的小妖可招人疼了，才不会有仙人舍得收我们。树木，山川都还有自己的守护精啊！”
“哦，那就好。我以前一直以为妖魔鬼怪都是坏东西。”
“只是存在的形态不一样，哪有那么明显的善恶之别。骨头妈妈，我又饿了。”
“你怎么一天都在吃啊睡啊的，你到底是虫呢还是猪啊？”
“我才生出来不久，还很虚弱啊！”

花千骨随手在树上摘片叶子塞到左边耳朵里：“抱住了啊！”
“嘿嘿，正好可以给我当床睡！”
第二天两人到了昆仑山山脚下。
“糖宝，我会不会像上次去茅山一样上不去啊？”
“你不是有天水滴了么？想进一切结界，阵法里应该都可以。”
“是吗？可是上次我和朗哥哥就没办法从那个王八精的阵里出来。”
“我也不知道，可能是因为结界是用符咒固定的，但是阵法却在不断的运动和变化中，进去和出来的方式不一样，现在天水滴的能力还不够强大到可以全部破解吧。再说王八精的阵法可是妖怪里最厉害的！”
“哦，这样，好复杂啊。”
花千骨慢慢往山上爬，这里和茅山又是完全不同的风景。巨大的山脉，逶迤壮阔，无数的湖泊，宛若撒在群山间的一颗颗珍珠。湖水粼粼，碧绿如染，清澈透亮。群山倒映水中，犹如游走于画中。水鸟云集，或翔于湖面，或戏于水中。四处隐隐有白雾蒸腾，似梦非幻，果真是人间仙境。轻风送爽，瑞气环绕，气象万千，虹光妖娆，一派祥和景象。
而远处高高屹立的玉虚峰，玉珠峰，白雪皑皑，银装素裹，山间云雾缭绕，是多少人朝圣和修炼的灵气之地。
花千骨早已看得目不转睛，忘了自己身在何处，糖宝不停的催促她往前走。
“这里很多河流江川都是从昆仑山上发源，古河水向南注入无达；赤水向东流入汜天之水；洋水向西南流入丑涂之水，黑水则向西北流入大杅。而常常有六月雪的昆仑泉，传说是上古之神西王母用来酿制琼浆玉液的泉水。我们在现在要去的地方是瑶池，虽然已经没有了西王母，但是仍有蟠桃盛会。一年一次的群仙宴，世人所说的瑶池天宴就是在这里举行。届时很多仙人都会到场，玉帝和王母娘娘也会到，这次应该主要是商讨妖神出世的事。我们寂寂无名，又没有仙帖，从正门入，肯定会被天兵天将拦下来，四大天王都是傻大个，有理也说不清，所以最好还是混进去。”
“啊？混进去？怎么混啊？你还好办，爬进去也没有人会注意，我这么大一个，肯定进去不了啊！清虚道长怎么没把帖子给我呢？”
“清虚道长是一派之尊，去赴宴根本不需要帖子的。你又没有仙籍，一般的仙帖拿给你也不会放你进去。最近妖魔肆虐，仙界之中到处都守卫管制的很严，更何况是群仙宴这种众仙商讨对策的大事。不过只要换个形态，我们身上没有邪气，要混进去应该还是挺容易的。这昆仑山上到处都是些珍奇妖兽，不如你也变做虫子和我一起爬进去。”

content_en:
"Sugar baby, don't call me mom again! Others will misunderstand me! Just call me Qian Gu!"
"But you are my mother." Tangbao lay listlessly in Hua Qiangu's ear, holding a piece of steamed bun crumbs in his arms as a pillow.
"Well, at least don't yell like that in front of outsiders."
"Then I will call you Bones like my father. I like Bones!"
"You are a bug and not a dog, why do you like bones?"
"I'm not a bug. When my spiritual power improves to a certain extent, I will transform!"
"Transform? What? Turn into a butterfly? That's not even a bug."
"Well, I don't know either. But then I will be able to fly! I won't have to crawl around every day."
"Yes, it's so slow. If I were like you, I would never be able to reach Kunlun Mountain in my next life."
"Don't worry, we will be there soon. We should be able to reach the foot of Kunlun Mountain tomorrow. The Immortal Banquet will be held in three days. I know the way, so I will definitely make it in time."
"How do you know?"
"I am a goblin from the Immortal Pavilion, and I am responsible for gathering information and transmitting information. How could I not know this?"
"That's awesome!"
"Haha, of course!"
"By the way, what if I worship the old man Bai Zihua as my master and he takes you in? Should I hide you?"
"No need, I'm not a magician. I'm just a magician, and I don't have any magic power. There are a lot of spirits in this world. Kind-hearted little monsters like me are so painful that no immortal will be willing to accept us. Trees, mountains and rivers all have their own guardian spirits!"
"Oh, that's good. I used to think that monsters and ghosts were all bad things."
"It's just that the forms of existence are different. There's no such obvious difference between good and evil. Mother Bones, I'm hungry again."
"Why do you eat and sleep all day long? Are you a worm or a pig?"
"I was born not long ago and I'm still very weak!"
Hua Qiangu picked a leaf from the tree and stuffed it into her left ear: "Hold it!"
"Hey, it can be used as a bed for me!"
The next day they arrived at the foot of Kunlun Mountain.
"Tangbao, will I be unable to climb up like the last time I went to Maoshan?"
"Don't you have water dripping from the sky? If you want to enter any enchantment, you should be able to enter it in the formation."
"Really? But last time Brother Lang and I couldn't get out of that bastard's formation."
"I don't know, maybe it's because the barrier is fixed with talismans, but the formation is constantly moving and changing, and the way in and out is different. Now Tian Shui Drop's ability is not strong enough to be able to break it all. Besides, the tortoise's formation is the most powerful among monsters!"
"Oh, this is so complicated."
Hua Qiangu slowly climbed up the mountain. The scenery here was completely different from that of Maoshan. The huge mountains are winding and majestic, and countless lakes are like pearls scattered among the mountains. The lake water is sparkling, green as dye, clear and translucent. The mountains are reflected in the water, as if they are walking in a painting. Waterbirds gather in large numbers, either flying on the lake or playing in the water. There is faint white mist everywhere, which seems like a dream but not an illusion. It really is a fairyland on earth. The breeze is refreshing, the auspicious atmosphere surrounds the place, the atmosphere is endless, the rainbow light is enchanting, and it is a peaceful scene.
In the distance, the tall Yuxu Peak and Yuzhu Peak are covered with snow, covered in silver, and shrouded in clouds and mist. They are places where many people make pilgrimages and practice spiritual energy.
Hua Qiangu had been staring at it for a long time and forgot where she was. Tangbao kept urging her to move forward.
"Many rivers here originate from the Kunlun Mountains. The ancient river water flows to Wuda to the south; the red water flows to the east to the Botian Water; the ocean water flows to the southwest to the Choutu Water, and the black water flows to the northwest. The Kunlun Spring, where there is often snow in June, is said to be the spring water used by the ancient god Queen Mother of the West to brew jade liquid. The place we are going to now is Yaochi, although the Queen Mother of the West is no longer there.But there is still a peach festival. The annual banquet of immortals, what the world calls the Yaochi Heavenly Banquet, is held here. At that time, many immortals will be present, as will the Jade Emperor and the Queen Mother. This time, they should mainly discuss the birth of the demon god. We are unknown and have no immortal post. If we enter from the main entrance, we will definitely be stopped by heavenly soldiers and generals. The four heavenly kings are all stupid and cannot explain their reasoning, so it is best to sneak in. "
"ah? Sneak in? How to mess around? It's easy for you, no one will notice when you climb in. I'm so big, I definitely can't get in! Why didn’t Taoist Master Qingxu give me the post? "
"Taoist Priest Qingxu is a respected member of the sect, so there is no need for a post to go to the banquet. You don’t have an Immortal Book, and I won’t let you in if I give you an ordinary Immortal Book. Demons have been raging recently, and there are strict guards and controls everywhere in the immortal world, not to mention the banquet of immortals, a major event where all immortals discuss countermeasures. But as long as we change our form and there is no evil energy in us, it should be quite easy to sneak in. Kunlun Mountain is full of rare monsters. Why don't you turn into a bug and crawl in with me? "
